# Encodian

Encodian provides a suite of document management and automation tools, including Flowr, Filer, and Indxr, designed to enhance productivity and streamline workflows within Microsoft 365 environments.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/encodian/.

## Actions

- **Add PDF Header Footer**: Add HTML header and footer to a PDF.
- **Base64 Encode**: Encode a string to Base64.
- **Compare Text**: Compare two text strings and determine if they match.
- **Decode Base64 String**: Decode a Base64 string to a file.
- **Get File Properties**: Retrieve properties of a file.
- **Get PDF Metadata**: Extract PDF metadata and properties.
- **Hash Data**: Compute a cryptographic hash (MD5, SHA256, etc.) of text or file data.
- **Move File**: Move a file between containers.
- **Resize Image**: Resize an image by percentage or dimensions.
- **Unzip File**: Extract files from an archive.
- **Validate Email Address**: Validate an email address.
- **Validate URL Availability**: Validate the availability of a specified URL.
- **Watermark PDF**: Apply a text watermark to a PDF.
- **Write Range to Excel**: Write values to a cell range in an Excel worksheet.
